description: This Java class 'SlidingFragments' demonstrates fragment animation techniques in an Android application, including toggling between two fragments with animated transitions and managing fragment back stack changes.

classes.name: SlidingFragments
classes.description: Main activity managing fragment animations and transitions with toggle logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, and configures fragments and views.

methods.name: switchFragments
methods.description: Toggles between fragment states with animations and back stack management.

methods.name: onBackStackChanged
methods.description: Handles back stack changes to animate fragments accordingly.

methods.name: slideBack
methods.description: Animates the image fragment into the background with scaling, rotation, and overlay.

methods.name: slideForward
methods.description: Brings the image fragment to the foreground with reverse animations and overlay removal.

methods.name: onAnimationEnd
methods.description: Callback to reset animation state flag.
